summary: Pit-status HUD renderer. Given non-null render-surface parameters a5 and a6, it measures the 'Wijs' label width via sub_5531F0 to lay out five driver rows, renders the pit-repair status display for the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8 + 13004), prints each of the five slots' driver name (fetched by sub_4A47E0, looked up via BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC) into left/right text columns through StringFormatAndRender, and draws a selection box around the active slot (this[1], field +0x4) when that slot has more than one entry. Returns 0 after rendering; returns the initial value 1 when the render surface is absent.

local_names.this: HUD state object; this[1] (field +0x4) is the currently selected slot index
local_names.a2: screen X base used for the text column layout
local_names.a3: screen Y base used for the text row layout
local_names.a5: render surface descriptor carrying scale factors at offsets 92 and 96
local_names.a6: render surface descriptor carrying a height field at offset 28
local_names.v26: per-line label buffer offset, advanced by 64 per row

operations.description: Return-early guard: if either render-surface parameter a5 or a6 is null, skip the whole HUD render and return the initial result 1.
Measure the 'Wijs' label string: sub_5531F0(aWijs, &v27, &v30, 0) fills v27 (character count) and v30 (advance width).
Derive the text column positions: v27 /= 4; v32 = a2 + 11*v27 + v27/2 (right column); v31 = a2 + 11*v27 - v27/2 (left column); v28 = v30 + 1 (line stride).
Resolve the player vehicle pointer: v8 = v25 = dword_7C54E8 + 13004.
Render the pit-repair status display for the player vehicle: PitRepairStatusDisplay(dword_7C54E8 + 13004).
Guard on the slot's entry count: if *(int*)((this[1] << 6) + v8 + 40) <= 1, the currently selected slot has at most one entry.
Advance the selected slot index to the next valid entry: sub_49F170(this, 1).
Iterate five HUD slots (v9 = 0..4); each iteration renders one driver line and, for the active slot, a selection box.
Fetch the driver name string for slot index v9: v22 = sub_4A47E0(v9).
Guard on the name lookup: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v22, byte_5EC4CC) must find v22 in the string table.
Copy the found name v22 into byte_5EC4CC; when v22 is null, clear byte_5EC4CC[0] instead.
Copy the display buffer into the bounded stack buffer v42: sub_587DD0(v42, byte_5EC4CC, 31) then v43 = 0.
Render the left-column (position) text: StringFormatAndRender(v42, v31, v21, a5, a6, 1).
Render the right-column (label) text: StringFormatAndRender(v42, v32, v21, a5, a6, 0).
Guard on the active slot: when v9 == this[1], draw the selection box for the current slot.
Compute box coordinates from the scaled screen dimensions: v12 = CRTFtol(a2 * *(float*)(a5 + 92)); v23 = CRTFtol(a3 * *(float*)(a5 + 96)); v13 = CRTFtol(v28 * *(float*)(a5 + 96)).
Height guard on the render surface: if *(int*)(a6 + 28) >= 300 use a 1000-pixel offset, otherwise a 250-pixel offset for the box top.
Emit the selection-box edges: six FloatToIntConversionChain(&v36, a4) calls convert float coordinate pairs to screen integers.
Advance per-line layout state: v21 += v28; v26 += 64 (next line's label buffer offset).
After all five slots, return 0 (success); the null-surface path returns the initial value 1.
